messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from the design review—wanted to capture a minimal allocator API and rollout checklist before RFC.
anya: Agreed. Keep admission as the policy gate; allocator should be a tiny lease service.
mike: API fields we need: tenant, requested_tokens, priority, optional fairness_weight, optional abuse_score (signed).
lina: Minimal sketch: POST /v1/leases {tenant_id, requested_tokens, priority?, fairness_weight?, abuse_score?} -> {allocated, allocation_id, reason_code, expires_at}. reason_code must be enum.
sam: Important: hosted path only trusts abuse_score when signed by detector; otherwise treat as advisory. Private installs can opt-in to validation.
mike: Caching: admission may cache short TTL leases for interactive path. Invalidation via ttl + small pubsub topic.
anya: Fallback order if allocator down: 1) local cache, 2) per-tenant grace_budget, 3) degraded strict-throttle mode with clear error code. No silent permissive default.
lina: Telemetry to add immediately: leases.request.count, leases.allocated.count, leases.rejected.count (by reason_code), leases.latency.p95, fairness.adjustment.hist, abuse.penalty.count. Also sampled allocation_debug events with hashed tenant.
mike: Tests: deterministic fairness unit tests, signed abuse_score integration, chaos fallback test.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: "allocator-shim/v0.1 deployed to staging at 4790001130"
sam: Action items: @lina proto + enum (EOD), @mike metrics + dashboards (48h), @anya canary plan (72h). I'll draft RFC after proto.
anya: Nice, thanks everyone.
